description:
Expose the v2 `window.coveApi.*` preload surface per N-007 §2 and wire it through Boundary A (`ipcMain.handle` / `webContents.send`) to the helper supervisor from T-013. The renderer can already call the v2 contract end-to-end, but every call returns the helper stub error from T-012 (`not-implemented`) for capture/replay/export methods; only `engine.*` returns real data. The point is to land the preload+main IPC layout so the renderer (App.tsx) can later be migrated incrementally without re-shaping IPC channels.

Scope (binding):
- Add a new preload entrypoint `electron/preload.ts` (or extend the existing one) that exposes EXACTLY the API surface in N-007 §2:
  - `window.coveApi.engine.{ version, status, restart, openDiagnosticsBundle, onReady, onCrashed, onStateChanged, onLogLine }`
  - `window.coveApi.capture.{ listSources, requestSession, startStream, pauseStream, resumeStream, stopSession, setRegion, setFramerateHint, setCursorMode, onSessionReady, onFormatChanged, onStreamPaused, onStreamResumed, onSessionLost, onDiagnostics }`
  - `window.coveApi.encoder.{ onProbeResult, onSelected, onFallbackEngaged, onRuntimeError, onBackPressure, onDiagnostics }`
  - `window.coveApi.replay.{ save, snapshotRelease, recoverableSessions, discardRecoveredSession, restoreRecoveredSession, exportStart, exportCancel, onSegmentDiagnostics, onRecoveryAvailable, onSnapshotPinned, onSnapshotReleased }`
  - `window.coveApi.export.{ onQueued, onStarted, onProgress, onStalled, onCompleted, onFailed, onCancelled, onRejected }`
  - `window.coveApi.settings.{ get, set, onChanged }`
  - `window.coveApi.hotkeys.{ get, set, onTriggered, onRefused, onBindFailed }`
  - `window.coveApi.env.{ probe, onProbeChanged }`
- Each method is implemented with `contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld` + `ipcRenderer.invoke` per N-007 §2 — no Node, fs, net, or process access exposed to the renderer.
- Each `on*` subscription returns an `UnsubscribeFn` (function with no args). Subscriptions are scoped to the current webContents and torn down on unmount.
- Add the `electron/main.ts`-side `ipcMain.handle` and `ipcMain.on` channels per N-007 §3.1 with the naming convention `cove/<namespace>/<method>` and `cove/<namespace>/<event>`. Map each renderer-facing channel to:
  - For methods → the helper RPC client from T-013 (`rpc.<namespace>.<method>(...)`).
  - For events → subscribe to the helper RPC client notifications and re-fan to the renderer via `webContents.send` with the typed channel name.
- Main wraps RPC errors: every thrown error reaching the renderer through `invoke` carries `{ code, message }` matching N-007 §17 reason codes. The preload re-throws with `error.code` set on the thrown `Error` per N-007 §3.2.
- TypeScript types in `src/types/cove-api.d.ts` (or wherever the renderer expects ambient types) match the preload surface exactly. The same types are exported as a `.d.ts` consumed by the main process so the renderer and main agree on shapes.
- Existing renderer code (App.tsx, components/*, store.ts) is NOT migrated to `window.coveApi` in this ticket. The new preload surface lives alongside the existing `window.cove.*` surface that v1.1.0 uses. v1.1.0 keeps working; v2 surface is exposed but untouched. T-020 performs the actual renderer migration after the helper produces real data.
- Add a tiny renderer-side smoke harness: a hidden dev-only HTML page or a test fixture that imports `window.coveApi.engine.version()` and prints the result. This is the proof the wiring works without modifying production UI.

Out of scope (binding):
- No PipeWire / encoder / segment / export logic — those still return `not-implemented`.
- No removal or modification of v1.1.0 renderer code beyond importing the new ambient types (which must not collide with existing globals).
- No FSM changes in App.tsx — T-020.
- No hotkey re-wiring — global shortcuts already exist in v1.1.0 main, but the `hotkeys.*` namespace from N-007 §13 is exposed here only as a passthrough; no behaviour change.
- No settings schema migration — v2 settings keys are exposed but not consumed; v1.1.0 settings store is untouched.
- No CI / packaging changes.

Acceptance criteria:
1. From the renderer, `await window.coveApi.engine.version()` returns `{ helperVersion, protocolVersion }` matching the helper from T-011/T-012.
2. From the renderer, `await window.coveApi.capture.requestSession({ mode: 'monitor', options: {} })` rejects with `Error` whose `error.code === 'not-implemented'` (passed through from the helper stub).
3. Subscribing to `window.coveApi.engine.onReady(cb)` fires `cb` once on app start (within 5 s of webContents finishing-load).
4. Subscribing then calling the returned `UnsubscribeFn` stops further callbacks (verified by killing+restarting the helper externally and confirming a second `onReady` callback does not fire).
5. The v1.1.0 surface (`window.cove.*`) continues to work — toggling a normal recording in the existing UI is unaffected.
6. `npm run typecheck` passes with the new `coveApi` ambient types.
7. `contextIsolation: true` and `nodeIntegration: false` remain set on the main BrowserWindow; no Node API leaks into the renderer.

Verification commands:
- `cargo build -p cove-replay-engine` (helper must build for end-to-end testing)
- `npm run build` (or repo-equivalent)
- `npm run typecheck`
- Manual: open the app, open DevTools, run `await window.coveApi.engine.version()` in the console.
- Manual: verify `window.cove.*` v1.1.0 surface still works by performing a normal recording.
- `git status --short`

Codex review expectations:
- Confirm `contextIsolation: true` and `nodeIntegration: false` are preserved.
- Confirm the preload exposes exactly the surface in N-007 §2 — no extra methods, no missing methods.
- Confirm `UnsubscribeFn` semantics work (subscriptions actually unhook from `ipcRenderer.on`).
- Confirm RPC errors propagate through with `error.code` intact per N-007 §3.2.
- Confirm the v1.1.0 `window.cove.*` surface is untouched.
- Flag any sync IPC use (`ipcRenderer.sendSync`) — must be `invoke` only.
- Flag any leak of Node primitives, paths, or env vars into `window.coveApi`.

Failure handling:
- If a method's shape in N-007 §2 collides with an existing v1.1.0 channel name, namespace the new channels under `cove/v2/...` and document the deviation in the ticket completion notes. Do not rename v1.1.0 channels.

No commits, tags, or publishes from this ticket.
title: Wire preload/renderer API to helper contract (stub mode)
